errors.summary: Twenty-nine deduplicated system clusters have been observed in this fresh cycle. Eight added by the first complete delivery and integration chain are closed locally: split-child lineage, bounded-residual review acceptance, runner-output tracking, exact CI event selection, same-reviewer head continuity, semantic review self-correction, honest mitigated outcome progression, and preservation of both exact local refs and ENOSPC fallback diagnostics. Individual validation messages and repeated symptoms are not counted as separate defects.

automatic_self_corrections.summary: The checkout case adds three lifecycle-level self-repair clusters: the Stage-3 researcher corrected its own proof, the implementation author corrected the reviewed defect on the same session, and the reviewer corrected its internally inconsistent semantic report on the same session. Earlier Stage-1/3 repairs remain retained. No dossier, plan, implementation, or review was discarded because it made a new correctable error.

supervisor_interventions.summary: Supervision advanced one authenticated case through the full chain, returned exact findings to the responsible author/reviewer, and implemented seven general controller corrections exposed by that chain. Two run-level interventions bounded Stage 3-6 and implementation/review/outcome progression. The system authored the research, mechanisms, selection, plan, code change, review, and outcome evidence; supervision fixed pipeline mechanics and rejected overclaiming without replacing the substantive work.
